visual.general_description: Two-panel figure (A sagittal, B axial) of grayscale head images that appear to be contrast-enhanced MR slices photographed or captured with burned-in scanner text.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A is a sagittal head slice and panel B an axial slice through the upper cerebral hemispheres. Both show a band of heterogeneous brighter signal along the anterior frontal scalp and calvarium and carry overlay text with study date, scanner and sequence parameters and IV CONTRAST; only panel A also shows patient demographic text. Each has a small localizer inset. No arrows or annotations other than the panel letters are present.

panels.general_description: Grayscale contrast-enhanced MR image of the head in sagittal plane (panel A) with burned-in scanner and study text.
panels.detailed_description: Sagittal slice of the head in grayscale with the face toward the left. The brain, cerebellum, brainstem, skull and scalp are seen, and the lower left shows nasal, oral and upper airway structures including a rounded dark air-filled region. A band of heterogeneous brighter signal lies along the anterior frontal scalp and calvarium at the upper left. A small axial localizer inset with a line is at the upper right. Overlay text includes patient demographic text, study and image numbering, scanner and sequence parameters and the words IV CONTRAST at the bottom. The panel letter A is at the upper left. No arrows, circles or measurement marks are present.

pixel_observations: Sagittal grayscale head slice in the style of a T1-weighted contrast-enhanced MR, with burned-in overlay text on both sides.
A band of heterogeneous brighter signal runs along the anterior frontal scalp and calvarium at the upper left of the head.
A small axial localizer inset with a slice line is at the upper right; the printed scanner text includes MR and the words IV CONTRAST.
Left-side overlay shows patient demographic and study text, including a birth-date-style entry, sex and age, and study date and time; right-side overlay shows acquisition parameters.

caption_claims.value: Caption describes sagittal CT of the face showing an extensive tumoral mass in maxillary, sphenoid and ethmoid sinuses and a left frontal sinus soft tissue lesion with bone destruction; this is a caption claim, not a pixel reading.

evidence.quote: Sagittal (A) and axial (B) CT scan of face revealed an extensive tumoral mass in maxillary, sphenoid, and ethmoid sinuses and, also, a soft tissue lesion in the left frontal sinus with bone destruction on that biopsy confirmed metastatic MM

clinical_significance.statement: The authors present Figure 1 as imaging of the extensive sinus tumoral mass and left frontal sinus lesion later biopsy-confirmed as metastatic melanoma.

evidence.quote: CT scan of face revealed an extensive tumoral mass in maxillary, sphenoid, and ethmoid sinuses

limitations: The scanner text and image appearance indicate an MR acquisition with intravenous contrast, whereas the caption and text call it a CT scan; the discrepancy is not resolved.
The sinus mass, left frontal sinus lesion and bone destruction named in the caption cannot be localized on this slice or confirmed from the pixels; no arrows or markers are present.
The image looks like a photographed film or screen capture with glare and low resolution; some overlay text is cropped or unreadable.

panels.general_description: Grayscale contrast-enhanced MR image of the head in axial plane (panel B) with burned-in scanner and study text.
panels.detailed_description: Axial slice through the upper cerebral hemispheres in grayscale, inside the skull ring. Sulci and the interhemispheric fissure are visible. Along the anterior (frontal) edge at the top of the image there is a band of heterogeneous brighter signal at the calvarium and scalp, stronger toward the left of the image. A small sagittal localizer inset with a horizontal slice line is at the upper right. Overlay text includes study date and time, image numbering, scanner and sequence parameters and the words IV CONTRAST at the bottom. The panel letter B is at the upper left. No arrows, circles or measurement marks are present.
